classic-straight-abaya.title: Classic Straight-Cut Abaya
classic-straight-abaya.description: An everyday abaya in a light, flowing premium crepe with a straight cut, wide sleeves and concealed stitching. A practical design for work and daily occasions.

gold-embroidered-evening-dress.title: Gold-Thread Embroidered Evening Dress
gold-embroidered-evening-dress.description: A long evening dress with hand embroidery in gold thread on the bodice and sleeves, a full satin lining and a concealed back zip.

gold-trim-embroidered-abaya.title: Gold-Trim Embroidered Abaya
gold-trim-embroidered-abaya.description: An occasion abaya in Emirati Nada fabric with gold ribbon embroidery on the sleeves and front edges.

printed-silk-scarf.title: Printed Silk Scarf
printed-silk-scarf.description: A 100% natural silk scarf with an exclusive Layan print and hand-stitched edges. Comes in an elegant gift box.

medium-leather-handbag.title: Medium Leather Handbag
medium-leather-handbag.description: A genuine leather bag with a geometric design, an adjustable shoulder strap and a cotton lining with two inner pockets.

puff-sleeve-day-dress.title: Puff-Sleeve Day Dress
puff-sleeve-day-dress.description: A comfortable cotton midi day dress with puff sleeves, practical side pockets and a detachable waist belt.

beaded-embroidered-shayla.title: Beaded Embroidered Shayla
beaded-embroidered-shayla.description: A Korean chiffon shayla with delicate bead embroidery along the edges — light, stays in place and needs no ironing.

mini-chain-evening-bag.title: Mini Chain Evening Bag
mini-chain-evening-bag.description: A clutch with a gold metal clasp and a concealable shoulder chain, with room for your phone and essentials.

practical-side-pocket-abaya.title: Practical Side-Pocket Abaya
practical-side-pocket-abaya.description: A light everyday abaya with hidden side pockets and front buttons, in a crease-resistant fabric for travel and work.

floral-casual-dress.title: Floral Casual Dress
floral-casual-dress.description: A relaxed casual dress with a soft floral print in cool viscose for summer days.

open-sleeve-black-abaya.title: Open-Sleeve Black Abaya
open-sleeve-black-abaya.description: A classic black abaya with wide open sleeves and a flowing cut, in premium Korean silk fabric.

small-leather-backpack.title: Small Leather Backpack
small-leather-backpack.description: An elegant backpack in a practical size with soft leather, gold metal zips and two adjustable straps.
